description: This file defines functions, enums, and includes for managing git reset operations in the libgit2 library.

methods.name: git_reset
methods.description: Resets the current head to a specified commit and optionally resets index and working tree.

methods.name: git_reset_from_annotated
methods.description: Resets the head using an annotated commit, allowing for precise reflog messages.

methods.name: git_reset_default
methods.description: Updates index entries from the target commit tree based on pathspecs.
